draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Theo,

Glad to hear things are going well, and that the layout is starting to click -- no complaints is a good sign this early. Your cancellation timing question looks closed out on our side, so shout if anything there still feels unresolved.

Since you've got your first project up, the next step most teams find useful is getting tasks living inside it, since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them. Want me to take 15 minutes with you this week to map your current work into it?

Best,
Priya
